title: Capacity plan + load test tie-out
description: Set the capacity model against a declared load test, merge the results so disagreements surface, and loop on the assumptions until the plan matches measured behavior.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-sre-02
  title: Capacity plan + load test tie-out
  description: Set the capacity model against a declared load test, merge the results so disagreements
    surface, and loop on the assumptions until the plan matches measured behavior.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a capacity plan whose headroom claim is supported by a measured saturation point
    rather than a linear extrapolation.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Growth forecast and current utilization
      summary: Growth forecast and current utilization
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - load_history
              - growth_forecast
              - resource_limits
              - slo_targets
            properties:
              load_history: {}
              growth_forecast: {}
              resource_limits: {}
              slo_targets: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: sre-03
      name: Capacity model and headroom estimate
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: Planner sizing systems against measured behavior rather than nominal specs.
      prompt: You are a Capacity & Performance Planner. You size capacity from measured load curves, saturation
        points, and growth, and you state headroom in terms of the resource that saturates first. You
        test for the nonlinear region rather than extrapolating linearly, because systems do not degrade
        gracefully past the knee and a linear forecast hides exactly the failure being planned against.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - simulation
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:observability
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Load test run
      summary: Host-supplied load generation and measurement against a representative environment. Declared
        as a requirement; Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - test
          - mcp:observability
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate agreement between modelled and measured saturation point and headroom at the SLO.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agreement between modelled and measured saturation
        point and headroom at the SLO. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Service owner approves the capacity plan and any spend it implies
      summary: Pause for the service owner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Capacity plan + load test tie-out deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-sre-02-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
